headers.//: Security headers for everything Vercel's edge serves directly (the built SPA shell and static assets under /assets). This is the layer the black-box scan hit — the landing HTML returns `Server: Vercel` and never passes through the Express middleware, so its headers must be set here. /api/* is excluded because the Express app (server/securityHeaders.ts) already sets these on its own responses; excluding it avoids conflicting duplicate headers regardless of how /api is routed.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/style https://fonts.googleapis.com; style-src-attr 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/ https://cloudflareinsights.com; frame-src https://accounts.google.com/gsi/; form-action 'self'
